mapper.select: select c.nombre as c_nombre, c.documento as c_documento, c.telefono as c_telefono, c.direccion as c_direccion, c.email as c_email, c.vetado as c_vetado, ir.id as ir_id, ir.fechainiciorenta as ir_fechainiciorenta, ir.fechafinrenta as ir_fechafinrenta, i.id as ir_item_id, i.nombre as ir_item_nombre, i.descripcion as ir_item_descripcion, i.fechalanzamiento as ir_item_fechalanzamiento, i.tarifaxdia as ir_item_tarifaxdia, i.formatorenta as ir_item_formatorenta, i.genero as ir_item_genero, ti.id as ir_item_tipo_id, ti.descripcion as ir_item_tipo_descripcion from VI_CLIENTES as c left join VI_ITEMRENTADO as ir on c.documento = ir.CLIENTES_documento left join VI_ITEMS as i on ir.ITEMS_id = i.id left join VI_TIPOITEM as ti on i.TIPOITEM_id = ti.id
